content.value_statement: Architecture choices often lack clear requirements, trade-offs, and decision records. This skill guides context discovery, pattern selection, and ADR documentation.
actual_capabilities: Collects project context through scale, team, timeline, domain, and constraint questions.
Classifies projects as MVP, SaaS, or enterprise based on documented decision criteria.
Compares architecture patterns by complexity, fit, and simpler alternatives.
Provides ADR templates for context, decisions, trade-offs, consequences, and revisit triggers.
Shows example decisions for MVP, SaaS, and enterprise systems.
limitations: Does not validate runtime performance, security controls, or infrastructure capacity.
Does not replace review by experienced architects or domain experts.
Requires accurate project context before recommendations can be reliable.
Focuses on architecture guidance, not implementation code generation.

use_cases.title: Plan an MVP Architecture
use_cases.description: Choose simple patterns, identify deferred complexity, and document trade-offs for a fast product launch.

use_cases.title: Evaluate SaaS Design Options
use_cases.description: Compare modular monolith, repository, DDD, caching, and synchronous workflow choices against team and scale constraints.

use_cases.title: Record Enterprise Decisions
use_cases.description: Create ADRs for distributed systems, service boundaries, event-driven communication, and operational requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Start Context Discovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for basic architecture guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this architecture skill to ask the required context questions for my project. Focus on scale, team, timeline, domain, and constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this architecture skill to compare architecture patterns for my project. Recommend the simplest valid option and explain when to revisit it.

prompt_templates.title: Draft an ADR
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this architecture skill to draft an ADR for this decision. Include context, options considered, rationale, trade-offs, consequences, and revisit triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Review Architecture Trade-offs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this architecture skill to audit my proposed architecture. Identify over-engineering, missing constraints, unresolved trade-offs, and safer migration paths.

output_examples.input: I am building an e-commerce MVP with one developer and fewer than 1,000 users.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend a simple monolith, direct ORM usage, hosted payments, and ADRs that document deferred scaling work.

output_examples.input: Our SaaS team has eight developers and separate billing, user, and product domains.
output_examples.output: The skill would compare a modular monolith with microservices and explain why delayed service extraction may reduce early complexity.

output_examples.input: We need to record why we chose event-driven communication for a high-scale product.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce an ADR outline covering consistency trade-offs, message queue choices, operational risks, and revisit triggers.

best_practices: Start with context questions before recommending any architecture pattern.
Choose the simplest pattern that satisfies current constraints.
Write ADRs for significant decisions and include revisit triggers.
anti_patterns: Choosing microservices before clear domain boundaries and scaling needs exist.
Adding repository or DDD layers to simple CRUD without a concrete reason.
Documenting decisions without trade-offs, consequences, or future migration paths.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps gather requirements, compare architecture patterns, document trade-offs, and write architecture decision records.

faq.question: Can it design a complete production system?
faq.answer: It can guide decisions and documentation, but production designs still need validation, testing, and expert review.

faq.question: Does it favor microservices?
faq.answer: No. It encourages simpler designs first and recommends microservices only when constraints justify the complexity.

faq.question: Can it create ADRs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes templates for context, options, decisions, rationale, trade-offs, consequences, and revisit triggers.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run commands or inspect my system?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed files are Markdown guidance and do not contain executable command logic.
